axes.name: high_byte_expression_and_lifetime
axes.rationale: Unsigned 16-bit high-byte mask; all expressions identical for every input, temporary lifetime affects scheduling
values: WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context & 0xff00));

context = context & 0xff00;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)((context >> 8) << 8));

context = (context >> 8) << 8;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)((context / 256) * 256));

context = (context / 256) * 256;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context - (unsigned char)context));

context = context - (unsigned char)context;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)((unsigned int)((unsigned char *)&context)[1] << 8));

context = (unsigned int)((unsigned char *)&context)[1] << 8;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(((unsigned char *)&context)[1] * 256U));

context = ((unsigned char *)&context)[1] * 256U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context & ~255U));

context = context & ~255U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)((context | 255U) ^ 255U));

context = (context | 255U) ^ 255U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, helpFile, 1, (unsigned long)(context));

assumptions: WinHelp uses the documented far pointer and DWORD ABI; helpFile is independently MAPSYM-bound, never a hardcoded selector.
